name: Canva
description: Find and read Canva designs, and create one from a brand template.
long_description:
Canva's own hosted server. It searches your designs and folders, reads a design's contents, and creates a new design from a brand template.

You sign in through Canva in your browser and the scopes say what the chat may touch. Creating or changing a design is an external write and asks first.

auth.instructions: Sign in to Canva in your browser and choose what this chat may reach.

risk.notes: Reaches the Canva designs and folders your account can see. Creating or editing a design changes what your team opens.
